caption: Conceptual pixel-coordinate example, not measured data. Star: reference at (y,x)=(2.25,2.60); blue squares: supervised source pixels; arrows: truth-minus-source targets. caption: Sequential parameter-identical comparisons: H0 has bounded single-anchor offsets; S0 uses signed single-anchor offsets; P0 adds neighborhood supervision with nearest-truth ownership and per-truth weighting. P0−S0 identifies the joint support/ownership/weighting change, not its individual factors. Missing points interrupt lines. This is a constrained sequential ablation, not a complete factorial design.

caption: Complete score-ranked precision–recall curves, grouped at tied scores, using confidence-ordered greedy nearest-unmatched assignment within 3 px. AP is a non-interpolated recall-weighted precision sum; thresholded F1 uses the separate frozen maximum-cardinality policy. Each curve is one selected seed/configuration.
